alice.cs: Heads up — OxfordTech pilot traffic plunged ~60% overnight. Champion DM'd: "procurement paused while we RFP two vendors (NebulaAI + ModelForge)".
tom.ae: Yikes. Dashboard shows requests down, but no error spikes. Could be procurement hold.
liam.eng: quick check on our end:
```
# usage last 7 days by env
SELECT env, sum(requests) FROM usage_events
WHERE account = 'oxford_tech' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY env;
```
Result: prod 2.1k -> 800, staging steady. no 5xx / auth failures.
rina.revops: Sales ok to offer a short rescue credit. Finance wants RevOps ticket and an approved amount before we issue.
alice.cs: Language in DM looks like active competitive eval. We should move to rescue playbook: quick procurement sync + tailored cost delta.
tom.ae: I'll reach out to new procurement lead. Can we have a one-page price/feature delta vs NebulaAI?
liam.eng: I'll run a perf microbenchmark against their sample dataset and include tail-latency numbers + token-cost estimate.
ops-bot: ticket created: #9123 — oxfordtech_pilot_rescue_credit (created by rina.revops)
rina.revops: Please capture the approved credit amount in ticket #9123. Also tagging Rev for consumption tracking.
alice.cs: Proposed meeting agenda for intro call: 1) confirm procurement blockers, 2) run a short perf demo on their sample, 3) present pricing/feature delta + security artifacts, 4) offer 10-day extension + canary Dedicated slot if perf beat.
tom.ae: I'll set the meeting for Mon 5/12 11am ET and invite our champion + procurement. Pre-read: https://redwood.internal/sales/oxfordtech/pre-read (internal).
liam.eng: I'll prepare a 1-slide perf summary + quick quantization recommendation. Will include commands I used and expected cost/throughput.
rina.revops: I'll note approval path and ensure finance has the ticket link. If procurement asks for a written SLA comparison, I'll pull our SLA matrix.
alice.cs: Action recap: @tom - outreach + meeting, @liam - perf one-pager, @rina - ticket tracking & SLA table, i'll run the call and own follow-ups. Target: resolve in 7 business days.
tom.ae: Got it.
